answer_1.quote: A typical Neural Machine Translation (NMT) system is a Seq2Seq architecture , where each source sentence (X) is encoded by the encoder into a sequence of hidden states.

answer_2.quote: We used the standard set of MT evaluation metrics: BLEU and METEOR.

answer_3.quote: As with the automatic evaluation results, similar conclusions could be drawn from the results of the assessment with the three semantic metrics used in the reward formulation: Sentence Fluency, Token-level Semantic Similarity (TLSS) and Sentence-level Semantic Similarity (SLSS) scores.

answer_4.quote: Finally, to gain deeper insights, we performed human evaluation on the translations of the OpenSubtitles and IWSLT 2014 test sets by the Transformer, Async-ACQ-BLEU and the best performing SURF variants.
answer_4.guideline: A rank of quality is assigned by the human evaluator (second author, fluent speaker of both English and German) from 1 to 3, allowing ties.
